verdict.line: You lose if you trade blade-to-blade before level 6; you win if you starve Aatrox off farm and pop Fury of the Sands after level 6.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's Q (The Darkin Blade) threatens three sequential slams and his E (Umbral Dash, cooldown 9/8/7/6/5s) heals him on every hit he lands, so he out-trades you in any extended exchange before you have levels or items. Nasus has no way to interrupt that sustain pre-6, so this matchup is decided by whether you can farm Q (Siphoning Strike) stacks safely at range 255 instead of fighting, and flip the lane once R (Fury of the Sands) is up.

theirWindow.when: Umbral Dash is up and he's near minions
theirWindow.what: He can dash onto you for free poke and sustain off his E passive heal, then follow with Q swings. Back off wave or let him burn the dash on a minion before you commit a Siphoning Strike.

yourWindow.when: level 6+ and his E/Q are both down
yourWindow.what: Cast R (Fury of the Sands) and go all-in — the duration gives you bonus Health and Attack Range plus max-Health drain damage that he can't out-heal without his own cooldowns up.

start.why: 48.8% win rate over 2,315 games and the most-picked start (65.3%) — the regen and flat damage reduction blunt his Q poke while you last-hit instead of trading.

boots.why: 48.9% win rate over 1,235 games — the physical damage reduction directly dulls his Q and empowered-auto burst during his all-in windows.

core.why: Core item in both top-performing build paths (57.5% and 59.3% win rate) — the proc damage lets your Q stacks and Wither-slowed chases actually kill.
Paired with Trinity Force in the 57.5%-win-rate path over 200 games — the attack speed slow punishes his auto-reliant Deathbringer Stance procs.
Appears in the 59.3%-win-rate path (108 games) — the healing-reduction passive directly counters his Umbral Dash and Deathbringer Stance sustain.

situational.when: he's building ahead and you need your own sustain to out-scale his heals
you need the healing-reduction and armor online earlier than a full Thornmail spike
you want the Wither-chase combo to actually stick on a mobile Aatrox

runes.keystoneWhy: 48.1% win rate and the most-picked page (50.8%) — the sustain and movement speed let you reset after poke exchanges without losing CS, which is the entire lane plan here.

summoners.why: 49.7% win rate, the highest of the three combos — Flash dodges his Infernal Chains (W) pull-back angle and Ghost closes distance for your all-in once R (Fury of the Sands) is live.

playing.title: Farm Q, don't trade Q
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike has only 255 range, so use it purely for the slain-minion stack bonus and avoid standing in his Q's threat range to do it.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown, not his position
playing.detail: Umbral Dash (9/8/7/6/5s) is both his engage and his sustain — if it's down, he's far weaker in a trade; if it's up, assume he can close the gap instantly.

playing.title: Hold Wither for his dash, not his auto
playing.detail: W (Wither) decelerates Movement and Attack Speed — land it the moment he commits Umbral Dash so he can't kite the slow or re-engage.

playing.title: Don't fight before 6
playing.detail: Without Fury of the Sands you have no answer to three Q swings plus an E-sustained all-in; disengage and let minions soak the trade.

playing.title: All-in the instant R is up with his cooldowns down
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands grants bonus Health, Attack Range, and max-Health drain damage — this is your only clean kill window, so bait his E/Q out first with Spirit Fire poke.

playing.title: Use Spirit Fire to deny his all-in angle
playing.detail: E (Spirit Fire) reduces Armor in its zone for 12s cooldown — drop it where he'd dash in so any trade he starts there bleeds him faster than you.

playing.title: Play for scaling, not lane kills
playing.detail: Solo-kill advantage favors him, so prioritize safe CS and Q stacks over forcing skirmishes; your stacked Q damage and Trinity Force core eventually outscale his kit.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the lane-timing and trade-window reasoning is my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Keep your distance from Aatrox while keeping the range of his (Q)-(E) in mind. Focus on farming with [Q] and purchase Bramble Vest, and go in for the kill post level 6 with Spellbook + Fury of the Sands [R].
